purpose: Teach: 王道/東京タワー/大相撲/バッター/金メダル/声優/ジョギング/レア

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、王道、絶対、のアニメ、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm being serious—I really do love those classic-style anime. I really mean it.
lines.style: Warm and earnest, leaning into his attention. Soft emphasis on the sincerity. Open posture, like she's inviting him into something she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、東京タワー、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm being serious—I really did go to Tokyo Tower with Dad. I really did!
lines.style: Bright and eager, words tumbling forward. Quick pace, genuine excitement in the declaration. Slight breathiness like he's had this to tell her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、大相撲、絶対、見たいと思ってるの
lines.en: Sho, I'm being serious—I really do want to see grand sumo. I've been thinking about it a lot.
lines.style: Gentle admission, like she's revealing something she's been turning over in her mind. Soft intensity. Unhurried, almost confessional tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、バッター、絶対、頑張ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm being serious—I'm really working hard at baseball. Really hard!
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Steady delivery, eyes up. Not boasting—stating a fact about himself he wants her to know. Small, genuine emphasis.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、金メダル、絶対、選手、絶対、テレビで、絶対、見たわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm being serious—I actually saw a gold medalist on TV the other day. It was amazing.
lines.style: Animated and present, leaning forward slightly in the telling. Warm energy without performing. Quick tempo on the reveal, like she wants to share the moment with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お気に入りの、本気で、絶対、声優、絶対、いるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm being serious—I actually have a favorite voice actor. He's really good!
lines.style: Earnest discovery in his voice. Speaking a little faster, excited to share something specific about himself. Small laugh underneath, like he knows it matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ジョギング、絶対、毎朝、絶対、してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm being serious—I really do go jogging every morning. Every single morning.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and grounded, a hint of pride in the discipline. Warm but steady, like she's letting him see something real about her daily life.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、レア、絶対、なカード、絶対、ゲットしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm being serious—I really did get a rare card! I got it!
lines.style: Peak excitement, words bright and quick. The triumph in his voice is genuine and unbounded. Slightly breathless on the final assertion, pure joy.
